title: Robot dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- shadow under dancing robot -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='92' rx='24' ry='5' fill='#2a2a5a' opacity='0.6'/>
  
  <!-- left leg (kicking out) -->
  <rect x='30' y='68' width='10' height='20' rx='4' fill='#4a90d9' transform='rotate(-20 35 78)'/>
  <!-- left foot -->
  <ellipse cx='28' cy='87' rx='8' ry='5' fill='#2ecc71' transform='rotate(-20 28 87)'/>
  
  <!-- right leg (standing) -->
  <rect x='54' y='66' width='10' height='22' rx='4' fill='#4a90d9'/>
  <!-- right foot -->
  <ellipse cx='59' cy='88' rx='8' ry='5' fill='#2ecc71'/>
  
  <!-- body -->
  <rect x='33' y='42' width='34' height='30' rx='8' fill='#e74c3c'/>
  <!-- body highlight -->
  <rect x='37' y='46' width='12' height='10' rx='4' fill='#f47c6e' opacity='0.7'/>
  
  <!-- left arm (raised up) -->
  <rect x='18' y='30' width='9' height='24' rx='4' fill='#4a90d9' transform='rotate(30 22 42)'/>
  <!-- left hand -->
  <circle cx='24' cy='27' r='6' fill='#2ecc71'/>
  
  <!-- right arm (down, bent) -->
  <rect x='72' y='46' width='9' height='22' rx='4' fill='#4a90d9' transform='rotate(-25 76 50)'/>
  <!-- right hand -->
  <circle cx='80' cy='43' r='6' fill='#2ecc71'/>
  
  <!-- neck -->
  <rect x='46' y='36' width='8' height='8' rx='3' fill='#4a90d9'/>
  
  <!-- head -->
  <rect x='32' y='12' width='36' height='26' rx='9' fill='#f1c40f'/>
  <!-- head highlight -->
  <rect x='36' y='15' width='12' height='6' rx='3' fill='#f9e07f' opacity='0.8'/>
  
  <!-- face screen frame -->
  <rect x='37' y='17' width='26' height='16' rx='5' fill='#1a1a3a'/>
  
  <!-- glowing eyes (happy) -->
  <circle cx='45' cy='24' r='3' fill='#00e5ff'/>
  <circle cx='55' cy='24' r='3' fill='#00e5ff'/>
  <!-- eye sparkle -->
  <circle cx='46' cy='23' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='23' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  
  <!-- happy mouth -->
  <path d='M44 29 Q50 33 56 29' stroke='#00e5ff' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  
  <!-- antenna -->
  <rect x='48' y='6' width='4' height='8' rx='2' fill='#4a90d9'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='5' r='4' fill='#e74c3c'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='5' r='2' fill='#ff9b9b'/>
  
  <!-- music notes floating -->
  <g fill='#9b59b6'>
    <circle cx='15' cy='20' r='4'/>
    <rect x='18' y='10' width='2' height='12' fill='#9b59b6'/>
    <path d='M20 10 Q26 8 26 14' stroke='#9b59b6' stroke-width='2' fill='none'/>
  </g>
  <g fill='#e67e22'>
    <circle cx='86' cy='65' r='3'/>
    <rect x='88' y='57' width='2' height='10' fill='#e67e22'/>
    <path d='M90 57 Q95 55 95 60' stroke='#e67e22' stroke-width='2' fill='none'/>
  </g>
</svg>
